articles.summary: Patient enrollment in MAVERIC surpassed the 50% threshold in early January and has now reached 75%. Target recruitment is anticipated by the end of Q2 2026, with the potential to extend into Q3 to accommodate patient enrollment from additional clinical sites.
articles.title: Cardiol Therapeutics Expands U.S. MAVERIC Phase III Trial Network to Address Growing Interest in the Pivotal Program

articles.summary: Heart failure is one of the most common serious medical conditions in the world, and by most measures it is getting worse rather than better.
articles.title: Heart Failure Is Getting Worse. Understanding Why Is the First Step.

articles.summary: Every therapy that reaches a patient's hands has passed through a series of clinical trials, each designed to answer a progressively higher-stakes question. The process exists to protect patients, generate evidence, and give physicians confidence that a treatment does what it claims to do.
articles.title: Understanding Clinical Trials: What Each Stage Means and Why Phase III Matters
